_comment: Synthetic MAXIMUM selection aggregate for Issue #1705 (dominated-branch collapse). Two branches feed a MAXIMUM aggregate: the ABSOLUTE branch is scaled by -1 (always <= 0) and is analytically dominated because a MAXIMUM can never select it while the RELU branch (always >= 0) is available. Fixtures only - no engine behaviour change. Input neurons are implicit (referenced as input-N), matching the production convention in ../../remove_neuron_propagation/network.json.
